<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This PR introduces a new Fjall-backed persistent database package (`@typeberry/database-fjall`) that implements `HybridSerializedStates` for in-memory state leafs with disk-persisted large values. The worker configuration refactors `HybridWorkerConfig` from synchronous to async to support backend selection between LMDB and Fjall. Consumer code in `mainImporter` and `mainFuzz` are updated to explicitly select between "lmdb-hybrid" and "fjall-hybrid" backends, with fuzzing defaulting to "fjall-hybrid" via environment variable.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#979](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/979): Introduces the original LMDB-based HybridSerializedStates and HybridWorkerConfig pattern that this PR extends to support Fjall as an alternative backend.
- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#965](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/965): Modifies fuzzing entrypoint (`main-fuzz.ts`) for persistent session management; this PR updates the same file for hybrid backend selection.
